clips.send: In 2008 China opened its first high-speed rail line. Fifteen years later it had enough high-speed track to circle the Earth at the equator. How do you move 1.4 billion people — and their food, coal and phones — around a country the size of the USA? Drag the year slider and watch the network light up, then find out where the rice, the sheep and the factories are, and why.
